We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

Let's parse: It's a tolyl (para methyl phenyl) attached to sulfonamide linking to another phenyl ring which is para-substituted with an α,β-unsaturated amide attached to an aniline (Nc3ccccc3N). Actually the amide is C(=O)N attached to phenyl with an NH2 ortho? Wait: C(=O)N c3ccccc3N meaning anilide with an aniline substituent (para? not specified). So overall three key disconnections: 1) amide formation between carboxylic acid (from Doebner modification product) and aniline (c3ccccc3N). 2) formation of α,β-unsaturated acid via Doebner modification from aromatic aldehyde and malonic acid. The aldehyde would be the phenyl ring bearing sulfonyl group? Actually the unsaturated acid is attached to phenyl ring (c2ccc(... )cc2). The double bond is conjugated to carbonyl. So we can disconnect at the C=C double bond to get aromatic aldehyde (c2ccc(CHO)cc2) and malonic acid. 3) sulfonamide formation between sulfonyl chloride (ClSO2-Ph) and aniline (the tolyl amine). Actually target has NS(=O)(=O) attached to tolyl (methyl phenyl) and to phenyl ring (the second phenyl). So sulfonamide formed from sulfonyl chloride (p-toluenesulfonyl chloride? Wait p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride is CH3C6H4SO2Cl). In target, the sulfonyl group is attached to the tolyl nitrogen (NSO2-). The other side of sulfonyl is attached to phenyl ring (c2ccc...). So the sulfonyl chloride would be p-toluenesulfonyl chloride (CH3C6H4SO2Cl) reacting with an aniline (the phenyl ring with the unsaturated amide). Actually the sulfonamide is N-SO2-Ph (the phenyl ring is the sulfonyl aryl). So the sulfonyl chloride is p-toluenesulfonyl chloride (TsCl). The amine partner is the phenyl ring bearing the unsaturated amide (aniline). So retrosynthesis: target -> disconnect sulfonamide to give TsCl and aniline (c2ccc(... )cc2NH). Then disconnect amide to give carboxylic acid (α,β-unsaturated acid) and aniline (c3ccccc3N). Then disconnect unsaturated acid via Doebner modification to give aromatic aldehyde (c2ccc(CHO)cc2) and malonic acid (HOOC-CH2-COOH). So three steps.

Now we need to produce JSON with each reaction node containing template_id. We need to find template IDs for these transformations. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria for each.

First, sulfonamide formation: functional_groups_formed: ["sulfonamides"]; broken: ["aryl halide"]? Actually sulfonyl chloride is aryl halide (aryl chloride). So we can search with functional_groups_formed ["sulfonamides"], functional_groups_broken ["aryl halide"].

We attempted earlier with ClS(=O)(=O)c1ccccc1 and got empty. Maybe need to specify "aryl halide" broken. Already did. No results maybe due to limited catalog. Could try without broken.
